_schema_meta.description: JSON schema definition for kb.ng.v1.0.json — the WellaPath Nigeria knowledge base artifact. Every condition object in the knowledge base must conform to this schema exactly. Field additions or renames require a schema version bump.
locked_principles: No PHI fields — no name, dob, phone, email, address
All token values must exist in token_dictionary.ng.v1.0.json
urgency_default must be one of the 4 locked enum values
explanation_template must never use diagnostic language — use 'may be consistent with' phrasing
Red flags always override scoring — not a suggestion
Artifact is immutable after publish — never overwrite a versioned file

condition_id.description: Machine-readable unique identifier for the condition. Matches illness_id from the Knowledge Base source sheet.
constraints: underscores only — no hyphens or spaces
must match KB source illness_id exactly

condition_name.description: Human-readable display name for the condition.

version.description: Condition object version. Matches the artifact version this condition was first released in.
constraints: Must increment when condition content changes
Major bump for schema changes, minor for content changes

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Scopes condition to a specific national context.

urgency_default.description: Default urgency level for this condition absent any red flag or demographic modifier. One of exactly 4 locked values.
constraints: Must be one of exactly 4 enum values — no others permitted

base_weight.description: Base scoring weight for this condition in the Nigeria context (1=lowest burden, 10=highest). Applied before symptom matching.

symptoms.description: Ordered list of symptom token/weight pairs for this condition. Each token must exist in symptom_tokens in the token dictionary.

token.description: Symptom token — must exist in symptom_tokens in token_dictionary.ng.v1.0.json

weight.description: Contribution weight of this symptom to the condition score when matched

red_flags.description: List of red flag tokens that, when matched, immediately override urgency to emergency. All tokens must exist in red_flag_tokens in the token dictionary. Empty array [] if condition has no specific red flags beyond globals.
red_flags.item_type: string — must exist in red_flag_tokens in token_dictionary.ng.v1.0.json

severity_levels.description: Severity tier classification using symptom token arrays. Standard conditions use mild/moderate/severe. IMCI conditions (pneumonia_children) use no_pneumonia/pneumonia/severe_pneumonia/very_severe_disease. Keys must be values from severity_tokens in the token dictionary.
severity_levels.value_type: array of symptom token strings — each must exist in symptom_tokens

demographic_modifiers.description: List of demographic modifier objects defining how patient characteristics affect urgency or scoring. Empty array [] if no modifiers apply.

modifier.description: Demographic token — must exist in demographic_tokens in token_dictionary.ng.v1.0.json

effect.description: Locked effect enum value — what action the engine takes when this modifier applies

note.description: Clinical rationale for this modifier — human-readable, not used by engine

seasonal_modifiers.description: List of seasonal modifier objects defining transmission or incidence patterns by season. Empty array [] if no seasonal variation applies.

note.example: Peak malaria transmission May–October in Nigeria

explanation_template.description: Patient-facing result text shown after triage. Must never say 'you have X' or 'you are diagnosed with X'. Must use 'may be consistent with' or similar non-diagnostic phrasing. Reviewed by medical reviewer before publish.
constraints: Must include a recommended action (seek care, visit clinic, etc.)
Must be written in plain English — no clinical jargon
explanation_template.example: Your symptoms may be consistent with malaria or another fever-causing condition. Prompt testing and care is strongly advised.

care_level.description: Human-readable care-seeking recommendation. Paired with urgency_default. Not used by scoring engine — display only.

local_expressions.description: How patients in Nigeria commonly describe this condition in local language or colloquial terms. Used for UI display and future NLP features. Plain strings — not tokens.

duration_note.description: Duration context note where clinically significant. null if not applicable. Only used for conditions where onset speed critically changes urgency (e.g. cholera).
duration_note.example: Symptoms typically begin suddenly within hours; profuse watery stools may cause life-threatening dehydration within 24 hours if untreated.

emergency.care_instruction: Go to emergency now — do not wait
emergency.engine_behaviour: Red flag override always produces emergency. Base urgency_default of emergency produces emergency regardless of score.

urgent.care_instruction: Visit a clinic or health facility today
urgent.engine_behaviour: Demographic modifier with effect=escalate_emergency or increase_urgency can elevate to emergency.

non_urgent.meaning: Needs care but not immediately life-threatening
non_urgent.engine_behaviour: Demographic modifier can escalate. Red flag always overrides to emergency.

self_care.meaning: Can be managed at home with monitoring
self_care.care_instruction: Rest, fluids, OTC care — seek help if worsens
self_care.engine_behaviour: Red flag always overrides to emergency. Demographic modifier can escalate.

_demographic_effect_enum.increase_urgency: Increase urgency level by one tier (self_care→non_urgent, non_urgent→urgent, urgent→emergency)
_demographic_effect_enum.increase_base_weight: Increase condition base weight for scoring — higher match likelihood, no urgency change
_demographic_effect_enum.escalate_emergency: Override urgency directly to emergency regardless of score or base urgency_default
_demographic_effect_enum.escalate_urgent: Override urgency to urgent regardless of base urgency_default
_demographic_effect_enum.monitor_and_escalate: No immediate urgency change — flag for close monitoring; escalate if secondary signs appear
_demographic_effect_enum.routine_caution: Clinical awareness note only — no engine effect on urgency or scoring

_seasonal_effect_enum.increase_base_weight: Increase condition base weight during this season — higher match probability
_seasonal_effect_enum.increase_urgency: Increase urgency one tier during this season
_seasonal_effect_enum.epidemic_alert: Epidemic season active — lower escalation threshold; treat with heightened concern

demographic_modifiers.note: Risk of severe malaria and maternal anaemia

_annotated_example.explanation_template: Your symptoms may be consistent with malaria or another fever-causing condition. Malaria is a common and serious illness in Nigeria — prompt testing and care is strongly advised.
